import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { getMatches, getLiveMatches, getTodayMatches, getStandings, getUpcomingMatches } from '@/lib/matches'

export const runtime = 'edge'

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url)
  const type = searchParams.get('type') || 'all'

  let data: any
  switch (type) {
    case 'live':
      data = getLiveMatches()
      break
    case 'today':
      data = getTodayMatches()
      break
    case 'upcoming':
      data = getUpcomingMatches(Number(searchParams.get('limit')) || 10)
      break
    case 'standings':
      data = getStandings(searchParams.get('group') || undefined)
      break
    default:
      data = getMatches()
  }

  return NextResponse.json(data, {
    headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=60, s-maxage=60' },
  })
}
